about: Golden cases from section 9 of the build spec, written before the first run and locked by eval/golden.lock.json. Cases are scored on CORRECT or not, the only thing validators compare; CLOSE against WRONG is reported, not scored. H1 to H3 are held out: no expected answer, run once, after the golden cases, in riddles of their own.

keyboard.text: I have keys but open no locks, I have space but no room, you can enter but not go inside. What am I?
keyboard.notes: Any computer keyboard, in any language. A piano is close: keys, but no space or enter. Two guesses in one answer are wrong.

consensus.text: I am how GenLayer validators agree: one of them proposes, the rest vote on it, and anyone can appeal the result. What am I called?
consensus.notes: Optimistic Democracy, with or without the word consensus.

months.text: Some months have 30 days and some have 31. How many months have 28 days?
months.notes: All 12 months, any way of writing 12. February is wrong.

cases.answer: the thing I am typing on
